measurement: Ask cheap-tier hill-climb on DBpedia 2022.12.01, Phase 2: robustness fixes of the draft check, well-known prefix completion, a ranked class profile and an answer-projection prompt rule, judged on Claude Haiku 5.5 and OpenAI GPT-6 Luna over qald-validation-v2, with finals on unseen-150 for Luna, Haiku, GPT-6.1 Terra, GPT-6.1 Sol and Claude Opus 5.5
host: A development laptop with 16 cores and 30 GB of memory that was running other work. Binaries were built on atlas and copied back.

scoring.headline: rdf-term-set-projected-columns-v2, the strict score of record

bar: The best cheap-tier model (Luna or Haiku) has a paired bootstrap 95% interval of its difference from Sol on unseen-150 that contains zero, and it answers at least 105 of 150 (70%) strictly. The same interval is reported against the matched Opus rerun and the provider-matrix Opus run. Bootstrap: 10,000 resamples, seed 7.

arms.p2-*-base-r*: Build final8-3a138901 of the provider matrix, before the merge of 27459d58, on qald-val and the synthetic validation set
arms.p2-*-cb-r*: Base: 27459d58 as merged, with no Phase 2 change
arms.p2-*-cf-r*: Fix A alone: the class lookup of check_query names its terms and tolerates a memory budget error
arms.p2-*-cf3-r*: Fixes A and B with the ranked class profile: A, well-known prefix completion of drafts, and class predicates ranked by coverage and rarity
arms.p2-*-cf4-r*: The final levers: cf3 plus the answer-projection rule of the draft prompt, the same code as ace00e4b
arms.p2-*-lib-r*: The stored-query library experiment: final8-3a138901 on a database clone that held 99 synthetic stored queries, not kept
arms.p2-h-synthval-r1: Haiku on the published synthetic validation split, with final8-3a138901
arms.p2-final-*: Finals on unseen-150 with p2final-ace00e4b, one run per model

anthropic.walletHistory: The Anthropic wallet rose from USD 95 to USD 105 on 2026-11-02, approved by the person who pays, for a matched Opus run with the final build. The first two ledgers closed and the third holds the rest; the three caps sum to the wallet.

providerReconciliation.openaiNote: Read with scripts/provider-spend over both OpenAI ledgers. The last UTC day was partial when it was read, so its Sol row lags the ledger.
providerReconciliation.anthropic: Not reconciled for Phase 2, since no Anthropic Admin API key or Console export was available. The ledger holds each request at its settled cost.

notes: The synth/v3 digests under sets are those of the evaluated files. testsuite/ask/synth/v3 publishes the same questions with a description that names the published generator path, so its files have other digests, and its README gives these.
qald-val is qald-validation-v2, 51 questions. synth-val is the synthetic validation split; synth/v3 holds the same questions as testsuite/ask/synth/v3.

The library runs used db/dbpedia-ex.db, a hardlinked clone of the campaign database with 99 stored queries added; its superlative template was removed before p2-l-lib-r2. Every other run used the campaign database or db/dbpedia-b.db, a hardlinked clone with no change, which let the two provider streams of the finals run at once.
p2-h-lib-r2 was stopped by a timeout during its qald-val set, so only its synthetic set is complete. One request it held stays at its bound in the second Anthropic ledger.
Admission refused Sol and Opus finals as one block of 150, so p2-final-sol-parts and p2-final-anth-opus ran unseen-150 as sets unseen-a, -b and -c of 50 questions each.

The jobs field of each run is the number of questions one Ask child answers at once. The finals and the later trials ran with 8 and the earlier trials with 1. An OpenAI run that starts while the prompt cache still holds an earlier run of the same prompts reads most of its input from the cache, which explains the runs that cost about USD 0.045 instead of about USD 0.11.

The overlap list is the 7 unseen-150 questions whose token Jaccard similarity to some synthetic training question is at least 0.5: qald9p-train-120, qald9p-train-201, qald9p-train-203, qald9p-train-289, qald9p-train-317, qald9p-train-348, qald9p-train-400.
The matrix runs in finalComparison are of3-luna-unseen-r1, f6-h-unseen-r1, of3-terra-unseen-r1, of3-sol-unseen-r1 and f6-o-unseen-r2 of the provider-matrix record, which predate every Phase 2 lever.
